meta.title: Oh-My-BBFF Widgets
meta.description: Root of the Oh-My-BBFF family for the DSH Web UI: right-sidebar status cards, global notes, and the BBFF settings panel that hosts settings from other Oh-My-BBFF modules.

ui.notesSub: Global notes · never enters a session or a model request
ui.settingsSub: Global settings · registered modules and diagnostics
ui.modulesSub: Modules register through bbffFamily / bbffUi; this block is diagnostics only and names no module.
ui.modulesUiLegacy: This settings section does not declare its owning module (legacy plugin)
ui.resizeCardHint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
ui.resizeStackHint: Drag to resize · double-click to equalize
ui.resizeColumnHint: Drag to resize stack · double-click to reset
ui.notesEmpty: No notes yet — type and press Enter.
ui.goalEmpty: This session has no goal yet. Write one and press Publish.
ui.agentTodosEmpty: The agent has not written todos yet.
ui.exposureHint: Checkboxes affect only this session and its subagents
ui.serviceFailure.contextMissing: The application context is unavailable. Reopen the panel.
ui.serviceFailure.serviceMissing: A required application service does not exist, so the action cannot run.
ui.serviceFailure.accessThrew: Reading the application service failed, so the action cannot run.
ui.serviceFailure.methodMissing: The application service lacks the required operation.
ui.serviceFailure.callThrew: Calling the application service failed; the action was not completed.
ui.serviceFailure.navigation: Usable navigation information is missing, so the target cannot be opened.
ui.settings.saveFailed: Settings were not saved. Check the input or reload; details are kept in diagnostics.
ui.settings.descriptorsUnavailable: Settings descriptors are not available yet; the raw settings data is kept in diagnostics.
ui.settings.resetLayoutTitle: Resets only the layout, card heights and folding; notes, goal history and exposure state are kept, and hidden or unloaded cards keep their layout slot.
ui.settings.resetTitle: Resetting settings keeps the browser layout, notes, goal history and exposure records.
ui.settings.language.title: Language files
ui.settings.language.hint: One JSON file per language. Copy the exported template, translate the values and reload — no restart needed.
ui.settings.language.failed: Language files could not be read: {detail}
ui.listOrdering.created-fallback: By creation time (completion and update time unavailable)
ui.listOrdering.goal-unknown-time: Completion and update time unknown; shown last
ui.listOrdering.goal-history: Completion time first; last update time when completion evidence is unavailable, newest first
ui.settings.effect.refreshIntervalMs: Lower values update the panel more often and read state more frequently.
ui.settings.effect.historyReuseIntervalMs: Higher values reuse old records longer, so history and tasks may update later.
ui.settings.effect.stateMaxSessions: Higher values retain more session states and use more memory.
ui.settings.effect.stateRouteMaxEntries: Higher values remember more session routes and use more memory.
ui.settings.effect.showDiagnostics: Show troubleshooting information without changing normal card behavior.
ui.settings.effect.autoOpenOnGoal: Turn off to keep the panel closed when a goal is detected.
ui.settings.effect.noteMaxLength: Higher values allow longer new or edited notes.
ui.settings.effect.notesMaxItems: No more notes can be added when this count is reached.
ui.settings.effect.goalObjectiveMaxLength: Higher values allow longer goal descriptions.
ui.settings.effect.snapshotMaxRoots: Higher values keep tool records for more offline sessions and use more space.
ui.settings.effect.snapshotMaxTools: Higher values retain more tools in each offline record.
ui.settings.effect.snapshotMaxBytes: Higher values allow a larger offline record file.
ui.settings.effect.cardPreferences: Choose visible cards and adjust their order and height.
ui.settings.effect.settingsSectionOrder: Saving changes the order of plugin sections on this page.
ui.settings.effect.displayLabels: Change displayed setting names without changing what the settings do.
ui.settings.effect.card.visible: Hide this card without deleting its content.
ui.settings.effect.card.order: Lower values place the card earlier.
ui.settings.effect.card.defaultHeight: Higher values give this card more vertical space.
ui.settings.presentation.helpLabel: Show effect of changing this setting
ui.settings.presentation.resetLayoutEffect: Reset layout, heights and folding without deleting notes or history.
ui.settings.presentation.resetSettingsEffec: Restore this plugin's settings without deleting notes, history or exposure records.
ui.settings.presentation.editLabelEffect: Replace this display name without changing the underlying data.
ui.settings.presentation.missingEffectNotic: Some settings have no effect text; existing descriptions or no text are used.
ui.settings.presentation.invalidGroupsNotic: Basic grouping data is incomplete; the legacy flat view is retained.
ui.settings.label.autoOpenOnGoal: Open automatically when a goal appears
ui.settings.description.sessionReadMaxSizeM: A session log larger than this that is also older than the age limit is never decoded; the session is reported as skipped instead.
ui.settings.description.sessionReadMaxAgeDa: Only a log both larger than the size limit and older than this age is skipped. The session this agent runs in and sessions you open explicitly are never skipped.
ui.settings.effect.sessionReadMaxSizeMb: Prevents decoding historical logs: DSH decompresses a whole compressed session log for every read, so large old logs are skipped with a diagnostic. No session log is ever deleted or moved.
ui.settings.effect.sessionReadMaxAgeDays: A recently written log is still read, however large it is: the rule needs both a large log and an old one.
ui.settings.description.refreshIntervalMs: Shared panel refresh period; it does not change the history reuse window.
ui.settings.description.historyReuseInterva: Independent of the panel refresh interval; controls the reuse window for goal history, todo log fallback and offline subagent metadata. Live events still update immediately.
ui.settings.description.settingsSectionOrde: One qualified settings section id per line; empty follows the contract default order.
ui.settings.description.displayLabels: Display names are stored in Widgets settings and restored together with the defaults.
ui.diag.settings.read-failed: Root settings could not be read/validated. Last/default values are visible; no existing file was overwritten.
ui.diag.settings.write-failed: Root settings write failed; no durable success was acknowledged.
ui.settings.rule.description: Root general first; then descriptor order (default 100), then qualified id.
ui.settings.fixed.description: The tool name, title and explicit-user-request privacy rule are fixed. It never reads notes proactively and settings cannot bypass this contract.
ui.error.settings-revision-required: A current settings revision is required.
ui.error.settings-need-reset: Existing settings need explicit reset/recovery before writing; their bytes were preserved.
ui.exposure.mcp-incomplete: The server list may be incomplete.
ui.diag.session-part-unread: This part has not been read yet.
ui.diag.sessionReadSkipped: Session log is {sizeMb} MB and has not changed for {ageDays} days, so it was not decoded (session-read budget: {maxSizeMb} MB / {maxAgeDays} days). Session: {sessionId}

ui.error.exposure-root-unresolved: Root ancestry is unresolved; preferences were not changed.
ui.exposure.not-exposed: Not exposed by the current session/view
ui.exposure.not-present: Not present in the current session/view
ui.exposure.not-in-mask-free-view: Not present in this mask-free session view

ui.diag.catalog-running: Catalog discovery is running in the background.
ui.diag.views.cold-limitation: Native JSONL/zstd still decodes fully on a memo miss; the Root folds only the new suffix. Cold sessions are coalesced per visible reuse interval and read at most once per revision.

ui.diag.views.log-shorter: The source log is shorter than the checkpoint watermark; this session is rebuilt.
ui.diag.views.anchor-mismatch: The checkpoint anchor does not match; this session is rebuilt.
ui.diag.views.migration-complete: The view was rebuilt from schema {from} to {to} (reason: adds the completion-time fact); {events} events, {ms} ms.
ui.diag.views.source-missing: The session source is temporarily unavailable.
